basic_info.description: Experience the very best of San Francisco living in this stunning top-floor view condo perched in the heart of Russian Hill, offering an extraordinary blend of charm, sophistication, and cityscape beauty. A 1,000+ sq. ft. private roof deck showcases panoramic views of the Golden Gate Bridge, Twin Peaks, and Downtown, creating a magical backdrop for entertaining or quiet relaxation. Set within a classic 1920s Mediterranean-style building, this rare residence combines timeless architectural detail with thoughtful modern updates. The spacious 2BD/1BA, approximately 1,250 sq. ft. home features vaulted ceilings, herringbone-pattern oak floors, and box-beam detailing in both the dining and living rooms, exuding warmth and character at every turn. Both bedrooms are generously sized and inviting, the kitchen offers ample space for cooking and storage, and the ideal 2BD floor plan provides effortless flow and natural separation between living and sleeping areas. With windows on all sides, the home is flooded with natural light and offers views from nearly every room. A private garage with EV charger and storage, plus shared laundry on the ground floor, complete this exceptional Russian Hill gem blending classic elegance and iconic San Francisco views.
